entries.4070e8675bdd1364: Operating profit was ¥10,748 million (102.0% year on year) and ordinary profit was ¥11,506 million (104.4%); both reached record highs, as did operating revenue. Profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥5,971 million (98.9% year on year). The gross profit margin fell 0.2 percentage points from the previous year, due in part to a higher sales mix of food products, but gross profit rose to 102.3% of the previous year as sales increased. Selling, general and administrative expenses were held to 102.2% of the previous year, despite upfront investments such as new store openings and wage increases. The Business Description section of the securities report states that, by the products sold and the form of sale, it mainly operates the "supermarkets and discount stores, general merchandise stores (SM/DS, GMS)," "home centers (HC)," and "drug & food" businesses, and it omits segment information because businesses other than "SM/DS, GMS" are of little importance as [[term:segment|segment]] disclosure information. Drug & food is described as the business of the consolidated subsidiary Aeon Welcia Kyushu Co., Ltd. (the company holds 51.0% of the voting rights). For this reason, the securities report has no net sales by business category. Net sales are shown by product category (food, clothing, etc.), and operating revenue, which is net sales plus other operating revenue, is shown with a breakdown. For the fiscal year ended February 2026, net sales were ¥520,588 million and operating revenue was ¥547,145 million (102.9% of the previous year).
